From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:03:00-05:00
Subject: Request: Hosted API integration deep-dive (SDK / streaming / tool calling)

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Acme Health would like to schedule a technical deep-dive to align on integrating Redwood's hosted API. Goal is to validate architecture, discuss SDK streaming behavior, and confirm patterns for tool/function calling and auth. We anticipate a 60–75 minute session.

Proposed attendees from our side:
- Alicia Torres (Product)
- Samir Das (Engineering lead)
- 1x Security contact (TBD)

Do you have a runtime/infra engineer and an SDK person who can join? Our availability windows:
- Mon Nov 16, 11:00–12:15 ET
- Tue Nov 17, 14:00–15:15 ET

If those don't work, happy to propose alternate times. We also have a short procurement checklist that Samir may share during the call.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Torres
Senior PM, Integrations
Acme Health

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API integration deep-dive (SDK / streaming / tool calling)

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clear objective. We can definitely cover runtime architecture, SDK streaming semantics, and recommended patterns for tool/function calling. I’ve looped in Monica (solutions engineering) to coordinate scheduling and provide a lightweight agenda; Karthik will cover runtime/latency trade-offs.

Both of your proposed windows look doable; Monica will confirm. Tentative agenda I recommend:
- 10m: Introductions & success criteria
- 20m: High-level runtime/serving architecture (Karthik)
- 20m: SDK streaming demo + best practices (Monica)
- 15m: Tool/function calling patterns & security considerations
- 10m: Next steps, action items, follow-ups

Attachments: Redwood_DeepDive_Agenda.pdf (agenda + checklist), integration-checklist.xlsx (procurement items you can pre-fill).

Can you confirm preferred window and whether you want recording enabled?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Adding a couple of asks from the infra side so we can prepare specific slides and traces:
- Could you share expected model family / size (e.g., 7B, 13B, open-weight or custom)?
- Typical sequence length distribution (p50/p95) and tokens per request
- Whether you expect long-running streams (open-ended streaming sessions) or short single-response streams

I’ll prepare: latency/throughput tradeoff diagrams, a small demo of streaming reconnect semantics, and configuration notes for batching and KV cache TTLs. If you can drop a short text file with two representative prompts, that would let us run a quick local perf simulation during the call.

—Karthik
